skills.problem: Weak generic repository/path token overlap can be mistaken for meaningful historical evidence and fabricate a risk signal for an unrelated subsystem.
skills.prevention_rule: Ignore generic structural path/repository tokens and require either an explicit path match or at least one informative matched token before verified history contributes to the risk profile.
skills.residual_risk: Future repository layouts may introduce new generic tokens; explicit path matches and fail-closed NO_RELEVANT_VERIFIED_HISTORY behavior remain the safety boundary.
